title: chat_bubble
summary: Benilla spawns the over-the-head speech bubble for SAY/YELL/PARTY and monster say/yell: the ChatBubble-Background/Backdrop/Tail construct anchored above the speaker, word-count-scaled lifetime with the self-vs-other asymmetry, 250 ms fades, the 20 yd per-frame range gate, replace-never-queue, and the mutual exclusion with nameplates. MSUI has no chat bubble at all - the only 'bubble' in the codebase is the chat-menu button icon; say/yell/monster lines land in the chat log only, and NPC dialogue never appears over the speaker's head.

openItems.text: No overhead speech bubble for any chat kind: no bubble frame, no lifetime/fade law, no 20 yd gate, no bubble/nameplate mutual exclusion.
